title: 差值数组不同的字符串
summary: 等长小写单词的相邻字符差值数组中，恰有一个单词的差值数组与其他不同，返回它。
insight: 把每个单词差值序列编码为键并统计频次，再返回频次为一的单词。
pitfalls: 比较的是相邻字符数值差

solutions.title: 差值签名频次
steps: 为每个 word 构造相邻差并以逗号连接
统计 key 频次并保存各 word key
返回 key 频次为一的 word

code.java: class Solution { private String key(String word){StringBuilder value=new StringBuilder();for(int i=1;i<word.length();i++)value.append(word.charAt(i)-word.charAt(i-1)).append(',');return value.toString();}public String oddString(String[] words){Map<String,Integer> frequency=new HashMap<>();for(String word:words)frequency.merge(key(word),1,Integer::sum);for(String word:words)if(frequency.get(key(word))==1)return word;return "";} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun oddString(words:Array<String>):String{val key={word:String->buildString{for(i in 1 until word.length)append(word[i]-word[i-1]).append(',')}};val frequency=HashMap<String,Int>();for(word in words){val k=key(word);frequency[k]=(frequency[k]?:0)+1};return words.first{frequency[key(it)]==1}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { string key(string& word){string value;for(int i=1;i<(int)word.size();++i)value+=to_string(word[i]-word[i-1])+",";return value;}public:string oddString(vector<string>& words){unordered_map<string,int> frequency;for(string& word:words)++frequency[key(word)];for(string& word:words)if(frequency[key(word)]==1)return word;return "";} };
